editorial:
Imagine you are spending a sunny vacation at a fancy Arizona resort where the staff is just as wild as the guests. You get to follow a super charming bell captain who is great at his job but stuck at the bottom of the ladder. He has his sights set on a promotion to manager, not just for the pay raise, but because he is head over heels for a woman he thinks is out of his league. The whole vibe is bright, colorful, and full of the kind of chaotic energy you expect from a classic hotel comedy, where everything that can go wrong usually does.

You will probably enjoy the funny chemistry between the characters and the fast movement of the plot. While some of the jokes are a bit silly, the acting keeps things light and breezy. It is the perfect kind of movie to put on when you just want to turn your brain off and laugh. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp resort views, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends. It is a simple, feel-good ride that does not take itself too seriously.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the main character finally proves he has what it takes to lead. After dealing with all the crazy guests and his rivals, he earns the manager position through hard work and honesty. The biggest win happens when he finally wins over the girl of his dreams. They end up together, and he finds a balance between being a boss and staying the likable guy everyone loves.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy hotel comedies and happy endings.
